summary: Iteration 4 verified the new gallery delete feature (UI + PIN-protected DELETE) and the image caching/perf fix. Backend: 5/5 pytest checks passed (GET /api/creations, GET /api/images/{id} Cache-Control + payload, 404 for unknown id, GET /api/settings/logo exists:true, DELETE /api/creations/{id} without PIN -> 401 and item still listed). Frontend: gallery loaded 22 items, thumbnails and modal image render at real size (modal img 504x756, not collapsed), delete panel hidden by default, confirm disabled with empty PIN, wrong PIN 111111 -> Turkish toast 'Geçersiz yönetici PIN'i' and item NOT deleted, correct PIN 574913 -> 'Karikatür silindi', modal closed, item removed instantly (22->21), persisted after reload and image endpoint returns 404 for the deleted id (soft-delete confirmed in Mongo: is_deleted true). Modal close resets delete panel + clears PIN. Exactly ONE creation was deleted; 21 remain. Event logo (Plena Pro) untouched. No LLM/Gemini calls made. No 429 encountered (paced requests).

minor.issue: Backend correctly returns 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400, immutable' at origin (verified on localhost:8001), but the preview edge (Cloudflare, cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC) rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Browser caching therefore will NOT take effect in the preview environment; only production/edge config can change this. Informational, not an app bug.

issues: Several seeded caricatures show the event logo rendered as a flat cyan rectangle / illegible placeholder instead of the Plena Pro mark (image-generation artifact in old seed items, unrelated to this delete feature).

critical_code_review_comments: GalleryView.confirmDelete: consider clearing the PIN field after a 401 so the operator does not have to select-and-replace the wrong value (minor UX).
delete_creation soft-deletes but never prunes the object-store file; consider a cleanup job if storage cost matters.
seed_data_creation: None created. Deleted exactly 1 existing creation (id 0d6ea866-c7e5-40eb-b4f0-cf35f72c08ac) as required by the test scenario; 21 creations remain.
test_credentials: ADMIN_PIN 574913 from /app/memory/test_credentials.md - valid and working for DELETE /api/creations/{id} via X-Admin-Pin header.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin rate bucket = 10 req/min/IP shared across settings + delete endpoints; pace admin calls. Cache-Control assertions must be made against origin (localhost:8001) because the preview edge overrides the header. 21 creations remain; do not delete more without instruction. Test files: backend_test.py, test_logo_placement.py, test_security.py, test_gallery_delete.py (all under /app/backend/tests). pytest.ini enables xdist, so run pytest without -n flags.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only deviation (Cache-Control not visible externally) is caused by the preview ingress/Cloudflare rewriting response cache headers, verified by comparing origin vs public responses for the same image id.
